info.name: Connectly API – Full Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive test suite verifying Authentication, RBAC, Privacy, Caching, Pagination, Likes, Post CRUD, Comments, Post Factory, User Management, Legacy Auth, and Google OAuth for all Connectly API endpoints.

## Prerequisites
1. Django dev server running at `{{base_url}}` (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000`).
2. If `SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = True` causes 301 redirects, set it to `False` in settings.py for local dev.
3. `{{admin_username}}` / `{{admin_password}}` must belong to a user whose **role is `admin`**. Create the superuser via `python manage.py createsuperuser`, then set `role = admin` in the Django admin panel (`/admin/`).
4. Import **Connectly_Environment.json**, select it, fill in `admin_username` and `admin_password`.
5. Run folder **0. Setup** fully in order before executing any other folder. Each subsequent folder is independent after setup.

## Test Folders
| # | Folder | Tests |
|---|--------|-------|
| 0 | Setup | Creates users (admin, user, user2, guest), obtains tokens, seeds fixture data |
| 1 | Authentication | Token endpoint – valid/invalid credentials |
| 2 | RBAC | Unauthenticated, Guest, Non-owner, Owner, Admin permission tiers |
| 3 | Privacy | Private/public post visibility in detail and feed views |
| 4 | Caching | Cold/warm cache, post-detail and feed cache invalidation |
| 5 | Pagination | Feed and comment pagination (default, custom, multi-page, out-of-range) |
| 6 | Likes | Like, duplicate prevention, unlike, unlike-not-liked, unauthenticated, 404 |
| 7 | Post CRUD | List, create (direct), PUT, DELETE, admin delete, unauthenticated, guest |
| 8 | Comments | Global list/create, validation (empty text), missing comment_id, 404 |
| 9 | Post Factory | Text/image/video types, metadata validation, invalid type, missing title |
| 10 | User Profiles | Admin/guest/unauthenticated profiles, invalid user creation |
| 11 | Legacy Auth | /posts/authenticate/ valid/invalid credentials |
| 12 | Google OAuth | Missing/empty/invalid token errors, manual valid-token test |

## Endpoint Reference
| Method | URL | Auth | Permission | Purpose |
|--------|-----|------|------------|---------|
| POST | /auth/token/ | None | Public | Obtain DRF auth token |
| POST | /auth/google/login | None | Public | Exchange Google ID token for API token |
| GET | /posts/users/ | Token | role=admin | List all users |
| POST | /posts/users/ | Token | role=admin | Create user with role |
| GET | /posts/users/me/ | Token | Authenticated | Own profile |
| PATCH | /posts/users/me/ | Token | Authenticated | Update own profile |
| GET | /posts/feed/ | Token | Authenticated | Paginated + cached news feed |
| GET | /posts/ | Token | Authenticated, non-guest | List posts (privacy-filtered) |
| POST | /posts/ | Token | Authenticated, non-guest | Create post |
| POST | /posts/create/ | Token | Authenticated, non-guest | Create post via Factory |
| GET | /posts/{id}/ | Token | Authenticated | Post detail (cached, privacy) |
| PATCH | /posts/{id}/ | Token | Admin or Author | Partial update post |
| PUT | /posts/{id}/ | Token | Admin or Author | Full update post |
| DELETE | /posts/{id}/ | Token | Admin or Author | Delete post |
| POST | /posts/{id}/like/ | Token | Authenticated | Like a post |
| DELETE | /posts/{id}/like/ | Token | Authenticated | Unlike a post |
| POST | /posts/{id}/comment/ | Token | Authenticated, non-guest | Add comment |
| DELETE | /posts/{id}/comment/?comment_id= | Token | role=admin | Delete any comment |
| GET | /posts/{id}/comments/ | Token | Authenticated | Paginated comments for a post |
| GET | /posts/comments/ | Token | Authenticated | Global comment list |
| POST | /posts/comments/ | Token | Authenticated | Create comment (global) |
| POST | /posts/authenticate/ | None | Public | Legacy authentication check |

item.name: 2. RBAC – Role-Based Access Control
item.description: Exercises the four permission tiers: unauthenticated → 401, guest role → 403 on writes, regular user → 403 on other owners' content, admin role → full access.

item.name: 2a. Unauthenticated
item.description: No Authorization header. TokenAuthentication with IsAuthenticated must yield 401.

request.description: Justification: NewsFeedView has permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]. Without a valid token the request must be rejected before any data is returned.

exec: pm.test('401 – post detail requires authentication', function () {

request.description: PostDetailView also requires IsAuthenticated. Confirms the detail endpoint is not publicly accessible.

item.name: 2b. Guest Role – Read Permitted, Writes Blocked
item.description: Guests hold a valid token (role=guest) and may consume data, but IsNotGuest and view-level guest checks block all mutating operations.

exec: pm.test('403 – guest cannot create post', function () {

request.description: Justification: PostListCreate has permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated, IsNotGuest]. IsNotGuest.has_permission returns False for role=guest on non-safe methods.

request.description: Justification: CommentOnPostView explicitly checks request.user.role == 'guest' and returns 403 before any data processing.

exec: pm.test('200 – guest can read the feed', function () {

request.description: Justification: IsAuthenticated is satisfied (valid token). IsNotGuest only blocks non-safe methods. GET is a safe method, so guests can read.

exec: pm.test('200 – guest can read a public post detail', function () {

request.description: PostDetailView.get_permissions returns [IsAuthenticated()] for GET. No IsNotGuest gate on reads.

item.name: 4. Caching
item.description: Verifies Django's in-memory cache backend (locmem) is active for both the news feed and post detail endpoints, and that cache entries are invalidated correctly after write operations.

item.name: 6. Likes (Like / Unlike Workflow)
item.description: Exercises the full like lifecycle: like a post, duplicate like prevention (unique_together), unlike, unlike-when-not-liked error, and unauthenticated access.

item.name: Fixture – Create Post for Like Tests

exec: pm.test('201 – fixture post for like tests created', function () {

request.description: Dedicated post to isolate like/unlike tests from other fixtures.
POST /posts/{id}/like/ creates a Like object linking the authenticated user to the post. Returns 201 with the serialized like data.
The Like model has unique_together = ('user', 'post'). Attempting a second like by the same user on the same post raises IntegrityError, caught and returned as 400.

item.name: 11. Legacy Authentication
item.description: Tests the legacy /posts/authenticate/ endpoint which uses Django's authenticate() and returns a status message rather than a token.

request.description: The legacy authenticate_user view uses Django's authenticate() and returns a JSON message. It does NOT issue a token – that is handled by /auth/token/.
When authenticate() returns None, the view returns 401 with 'Invalid credentials.' message.
